title: Band on the Map Source Registry Entry
description: Canonical, city-agnostic contract for one entry in the Band on the Map source registry. A registry entry describes a candidate or enabled data Source (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) prior to, or independent of, live ingestion. Technical monitoring suitability, onboarding lifecycle stage, and legal reuse rights are three separate concerns recorded as three separate fields (monitoring_status, lifecycle_status, rights_status) per docs/DATA_RIGHTS.md and docs/SOURCE_REGISTRY.md, and none of the three implies either of the others.
$comment: Invariant enforced by sources/registry/validate.mjs, not by this schema alone: an entry whose lifecycle_status is TECHNICALLY_REVIEWED (or later) must not have monitoring_status READY_FOR_TECHNICAL_PROOF, since that lifecycle stage means the acquisition path has already been directly proven (see TECHNICAL_PATH_PROVEN).

id.description: Stable application identity for this Source, independent of its URL. Never reused for a different real-world Source, even if the entry is later retired.

physical_address.description: Only meaningful for physical venues. Null for promoters, feeds, ticketing platforms, and rotating/no-fixed-address festivals.

events_url.description: Where this differs from official_website, the more specific page this Source's events/agenda is monitored through.

source_priority.description: Band on the Map's own priority assessment for this Source, independent of whether it was chosen for a first-wave cohort.

acquisition_path_detail.description: Free-text technical detail beyond the generic acquisition_method enum, e.g. a named, previously-established retrieval path documented elsewhere in the repository (such as AgendaLX's FRONTEND_EVIDENCED_CATEGORY_QUERY path, see docs/sources/AGENDALX.md). This field intentionally does not expand the shared enum with source-specific values.

monitoring_status.description: Technical finding about this source ONLY, distinct from lifecycle_status (its onboarding stage) and from rights_status (its reuse permission). READY_FOR_TECHNICAL_PROOF means the source looks technically promising but has not yet been directly exercised. TECHNICAL_PATH_PROVEN means the acquisition path has been directly exercised and validated (a real fetch, a passing contract test, a committed fixture) — it does not imply rights clearance, an enabled production collector, or scheduling. Never implies reuse permission; see rights_status.

rights_status.description: Preliminary rights class per docs/DATA_RIGHTS.md, reviewed as of last_reviewed_at. AMBER/UNKNOWN must remain unresolved rather than being upgraded on the strength of public accessibility alone. Never implies technical monitoring suitability; see monitoring_status.

rights_evidence_url.description: One or more URLs (terms of use, licence page, robots/accessibility statement) supporting rights_status. Null/empty is expected while rights_status is UNKNOWN.

overlap_notes.description: Known overlap with other sources/aggregators for the same real-world events. Recorded for later Event resolution; never used to delete or merge registry entries.

research_notes.description: Short, source-level notes necessary to explain a decision. Not a place for a full research transcript — see research_provenance and docs/SOURCE_REGISTRY.md.

detailed_source_ref.description: Repository path(s) to a more detailed, separately governed source contract for this Source, where one already exists (e.g. "sources/agendalx.json; docs/sources/AGENDALX.md"). When present, that governed contract takes precedence over this registry entry's rights_status/acquisition fields if they ever differ.

lifecycle_status.description: Onboarding stage per docs/SOURCE_REGISTRY.md. Scheduling/collectors are out of scope until a Source reaches ENABLED.

research_id.description: Identifier of the research task/report this entry was seeded or last reassessed from, e.g. "BOTM-RESEARCH-LISBON-SOURCES-01". Traceability pointer only — the full research report is not duplicated into this repository.
